review.train_scores: original genuine pre-update quality records; not fixed final-head evaluation
review.probe_scores: only aggregate loss in original logs; individual predictions require the small GPU probe
review.val_scores: same verified saved B boxes and final ep08 quality arrays, no new model inference
review.statistics: continuous-target MAE/RMSE; Spearman quality vs negative error; diagnostic AUROC with undefined zero-class groups; geometry/score associations
review.groups: all, domain and sequence, preserving missing outputs and TRAIN/evaluation direction roles
review.causality: descriptive associations and support differences do not prove a shortcut or a unique root cause

gpu_probe.case_selection: per domain, fixed ep08 first dataset index and maximum genuine center/size/angle error; ties image ascending; duplicate view merged; TRAIN only
gpu_probe.views: exact original TRAIN random augmentation replay using saved view_seed; exact image tensor SHA and metadata required
gpu_probe.B_prediction: current frozen B prediction retained and separately compared to logged output; old identity tolerances unchanged, differences recorded
gpu_probe.fixed_heads: same completed ep08 geometry/ordinary ROI/structure weights; no optimizer and no export of changed weights
gpu_probe.structure_input_zero: zero only the response descriptor input in the same trained structure head; restore its flag; distribution-changing sensitivity, not retrained ablation
gpu_probe.response_evidence: global center/line peaks; annotation-weighted response; line excess above median and unsigned PCA inside predicted B square context; flat direction undefined
gpu_probe.real_reference: validated native annotation axis, with no visibility or pixel-truth guarantee
gpu_probe.sim_reference: Webots OBB-derived finite-line proxy, no native axis
gpu_probe.gradients: existing quality loss vs response loss on shared stem; weighted genuine vs probes and three exact component contributions; autograd.grad only
gpu_probe.gradient_claim: local norms and cosines do not establish a training-wide cause or justify changing a coefficient
gpu_probe.online_inputs: detached P3, predicted B boxes/scores and metadata; GT/probes/axis used offline for TRAIN diagnosis only
gpu_probe.resources: one view and one frozen B feature extraction at a time; separate allocated/reserved peaks; no whole-FPN cache

invariants: original B/source manifests, ep08 selection, 15px/10%/3deg thresholds, direction qualification, isotropic transforms and original coordinate/depth interfaces unchanged
test_reporting: a future frozen four-method TEST report is allowed as exposed-set complementary evidence; no TEST-driven threshold/weight/method selection or claiming a fresh untouched holdout; this diagnostic does not implement or run TEST
